policy.permanent: A product or release invariant that remains after repository consolidation.
policy.migration_scaffolding: A temporary observation or compatibility boundary with an explicit retirement event.
policy.integration_merge_gate: Before pull request 407 merges, every migration-scaffolding entry must be reviewed and either retired, converted into a permanent invariant, or carried with its still-valid retirement event.

gates.purpose: Keep the protected test context fail-closed over unit, source, artifact, and two-distribution boundary checks without granting live credentials.
Prove disjoint wheel ownership, clean installs, one-way dependencies, lightweight base imports, and supported Python floors.
Retain auditable evidence of the imported source bytes, approved transformations, exclusions, licenses, and artifact boundaries.
